response_file_sha256: fill with SHA256 of completed frozen response file
custody_evidence_record_sha256: fill with SHA256 of completed custody evidence record
scorer_intake_sha256: fill with SHA256 of scorer intake at scoring time
non_claim: isolated-arm score-sheet template only; not a completed score, not cross-arm inference, and not compact-gate confirmation
self_hash_boundary: manual scoring occurs only after the frozen response and custody record bind the observed responder-bundle hash to scorer-side expected hashes
preanswer_material_boundary: This score sheet opens only after response freeze and custody record freeze. If it was visible before response, the run is not clean.
score_time_boundary: Score-sheet init records scorer-local opening, validates the exact custody bytes, then records a scorer-local custody observation. Finalize records local scored_at. Only these same-process times are ordered; the custody hash carries cross-operator causality.
identity_boundary: scorer_attestation.scorer_id must differ from responder_stage.responder_id; the custodian may also be the scorer so the minimum clean run still needs only two distinct operators.
artifact_binding_boundary: Init and finalize revalidate the responder-finalize-v1 response, exact frozen response bytes, exact frozen custody bytes, and exact current scorer-intake bytes. Finalization refuses drift and writes a new file.
rationale_boundary: Every metric for the one opaque arm requires a concise evidence-grounded rationale, including zero scores.
timestamp_trust_boundary: Scorer timestamps are descriptive local observations. The scorer does not compare them to responder or custodian clocks; exact response and custody hashes bind the stage chain.
